task.question: Which spacecraft did NASA and Katalyst Space announce on August 19, 2026 would no longer attempt to capture or boost the Swift observatory because of an attitude-control issue?
task.evidence: NASA and Katalyst Space announced Wednesday the LINK spacecraft will not capture or boost an agency satellite
task.page: NASA Updates Next Steps for Commercial Swift Boost Mission

answer:
NASA and Katalyst Space announced that the spacecraft "X-Plane" would no longer attempt to capture or boost the Swift observatory due to an attitude-control issue. 

FINAL: X-Plane
